templates/angular/chart.ts.judgment: Rows still require a valid chart model. Indent consumes chartPointRows depth as a semantic gap multiplier.

templates/angular/specialist-model.ts.judgment: Chart depth/cycle limits, Diagram node finiteness and coordinate bounds, and FileExplorer depth/repeated-ID checks still reject invalid data. Diagnostic translation does not supply the numeric values.

templates/angular/data-grid.ts.judgment: Table minimum width still combines a fixed 12ch text-width floor, semantic tokens and the number of configured columns. Column validation still guards the table; hierarchy messages and the separate indent path do not supply that width.

templates/angular/table-model.ts.judgment: Table guards still reject empty columns and nonfinite or nonpositive widths, including stored widths, and reject reversed minimum/maximum limits. Error text changes separately from these conditions.

templates/angular/diagram.ts.judgment: Rendered nodes still come from displayModel only after model validation and finite zoom in the 0.25–4 range. The left, top and transform bindings still use node positions and zoom.

templates/angular/diff-json.ts.judgment: The JSON view uses depth from the parsed row for indentation. Localized row labels and search do not supply that coefficient.

templates/angular/json-model.ts.judgment: JSON traversal still starts depth at zero, increments once per nesting level and rejects depth above 64 and row count at 10,000 before output. Parsing and diagnostics do not supply external CSS.

templates/angular/display-content.ts.judgment: Text clipping still uses validated integer lineCount and code numberDigits is derived from line length count. Other reviewed preview counters and render bounds still use their existing validated producers.

templates/angular/display.ts.judgment: Avatar grapheme count, MeterGroup value-to-maximum ratio, Statistic/Meter data values and Descriptions positive column count still use their bounded producers instead of message strings.

templates/angular/file-explorer.ts.judgment: Rows still require a valid tree, and indent uses explorerRows-generated depth. The hierarchy message and formatted file size do not supply indentation.

templates/angular/form-layout.ts.judgment: FormLayout checkedColumns still calls positiveInteger before the host property receives its structural count.

templates/angular/image-media.ts.judgment: Image and comparison ratios still use positiveMediaNumber. Comparison clip and position remain derived from the bounded percentage and direction.

templates/angular/media-model.ts.judgment: positiveMediaNumber still rejects nonfinite and nonpositive values, comparePosition enforces 0–100, and cropBoundsError still requires positive dimensions and a positive in-image rectangle.

templates/angular/scheduler-controller.t.judgment: Scheduler geometry still comes from schedulerLayout using current events and configuration. Translation changes result messages, separating them from date, coordinate and column producers.

templates/angular/scheduler-model.ts.judgment: Existing calendar/date/time validation and finite range clipping still determine schedule positions and lengths. The translation arguments carry only error and display text.

templates/angular/scheduler-view.ts.judgment: Existing style sites still consume schedule geometry or screen layout counts, while the localized text changes around those bindings.

templates/angular/selection-input.ts.judgment: MultiSelect columns still come from checkedColumns as a positive safe integer and feed repeat() only.

templates/angular/splitter.ts.judgment: Splitter geometry remains a positive finite height/viewport token and finite split coefficients, separate from labels and keyboard guidance.

templates/angular/virtual-data-table.ts.judgment: gridColumns and minimumInline still consume semantic widths, positive bounded column data and width clamps. Table configuration checks still gate the rendered rows.

templates/angular/choice-controls.ts.judgment: Palette values still pass parseColor and the palette validation before swatches render; translations do not supply background values.

templates/angular/choice-model.ts.judgment: parseColor and the numeric color representation stay the same. Changes to numeric choice diagnostics do not affect the palette parser.

templates/angular/drawer.ts.judgment: Drawer and BottomSheet still validate width/height with panelSize and sheet stages with sheetStages before writing pixel or viewport geometry.

templates/angular/image-cropper.ts.judgment: Crop preview still requires a session and a rectangle passing cropBoundsError. All four preview style sinks consume only rectangle and image dimensions.

templates/angular/mega-menu.ts.judgment: checkedColumns still uses positiveInteger before writing the structural count for the navigation grid.

templates/angular/text-input.ts.judgment: Textarea checkedMaxHeight still accepts only null or a positive finite value before setting the native editor cap.
